name: Fresher asks about US onsite deputation in the first user turn — wrong round

transcript.text: Hi sir, I'm Karthik, final-year CSE at NIT Trichy. Before we start, I had one question — when will I go onsite to the US? Is there a foreign posting opportunity for freshers in the first year itself?
